description: Add a dedicated transaction management workflow that lets users view, edit, and remove existing transaction rows using shadcn components with account filtering and pagination.

userStories.title: Add paginated transactions list API
userStories.description: As a user, I want transactions fetched in pages with account filtering so that I can browse large datasets efficiently.
acceptanceCriteria: Add transactions list API endpoint that accepts page, pageSize, and optional accountId
Response includes rows plus pagination metadata: total, page, pageSize, totalPages
Results use deterministic ordering to keep pagination stable
Typecheck passes

userStories.title: Add transaction update API with mutable-field validation
userStories.description: As a user, I want to edit a transaction safely so that I can correct data without changing immutable import metadata.
acceptanceCriteria: Add transaction update API endpoint by id
Validation allows only user-owned mutable fields and rejects immutable import metadata updates
Successful update returns the persisted row
Typecheck passes

userStories.title: Add transaction hard-delete API
userStories.description: As a user, I want a delete endpoint for transactions so that confirmed row removals are persisted.
acceptanceCriteria: Add transaction delete API endpoint by id
Endpoint hard-deletes the transaction when id exists
Endpoint returns not-found response for missing id
Typecheck passes

userStories.title: Create transactions route with account filter and pagination controls
userStories.description: As a user, I want a dedicated transactions page with filters and paging controls so that I can navigate transaction history quickly.
acceptanceCriteria: Add /transactions route and include it in primary navigation
Route includes account filter with All accounts plus specific account options
Route includes numeric page controls and page-size selector wired to list API
Typecheck passes
Verify in browser using dev-browser skill

userStories.title: Render paginated transaction table using shadcn primitives
userStories.description: As a user, I want a clear tabular list so that I can inspect transaction rows and current page state.
acceptanceCriteria: Use shadcn table primitives from src/components/ui/table.tsx for transactions list
Show total count and current page information in the UI
Show empty state when no rows match active filters
Typecheck passes
Verify in browser using dev-browser skill

userStories.title: Add transaction edit modal or drawer flow
userStories.description: As a user, I want to edit transactions in a modal or drawer so that I can update row data without leaving the list.
acceptanceCriteria: Each row includes an Edit action that opens a shadcn modal or drawer
Edit form pre-fills current row values and submits to update API
After save, the list refreshes while keeping current filter and valid page state
Typecheck passes
Verify in browser using dev-browser skill

userStories.title: Add transaction delete confirmation flow
userStories.description: As a user, I want explicit delete confirmation so that I do not remove transactions by mistake.
acceptanceCriteria: Each row includes a Delete action that opens a shadcn confirmation dialog
Confirm action calls delete API and cancel action leaves row unchanged
After delete, UI keeps pagination valid (including last-row-on-page removal)
Typecheck passes
Verify in browser using dev-browser skill

userStories.title: Add automated coverage for transaction management behavior
userStories.description: As a maintainer, I want tests for transaction list, edit, and delete behaviors so regressions are caught quickly.
acceptanceCriteria: Add tests for list pagination and account filter behavior
Add tests for update API validation and persistence
Add tests for delete behavior and pagination-state edge cases where applicable
Typecheck passes
Tests pass
